supported_claim: On the pilot-plant Warwick NMC622 calendering dataset, AIcoScientist achieved Hit@5 = 100.0%, exceeding the exact random analytical baseline of 33.3% by +66.7 percentage points.
allowed_slide_wording: AIcoScientist demonstrates pilot-plant calendering process optimization on physical NMC622 data (18 full factorial pilot conditions, 54 half-cells), rediscovering the source-observed optimal condition (EXP_03) with Hit@5 = 100.0% (vs 33.3% random baseline).
